visible.author: Colby
visible.title: Some fitment issues + noise, but works
visible.body: Took some time verifying the parts that I received were the correct ones for my truck, in the end they were. Brakes were not wearing all the way across the rotor on the face side, back side was perfect. Time will tell how things wear but, these pads are a lot more aggressive in sound, (especially under 50mph), but are smooth as silk when you mash the brake pedal, no vibration, no pulling to one side, no extra noise. The only issue I had was the passenger wheel was not correctly centered when I finished putting it back on. MAKE SURE THAT YOU FULLY TIGHTEN THE RETAINING SCREW ON THE ROTOR T30 BIT!!
visible.product: C&L Super Sport HD 6-Lug Brake Rotor and Pad Kit with Hardware; Front (07-18 Silverado 1500)
